task: Keep a searchable document archive on your computer

x-display.title: Organise a searchable document archive
x-display.summary: Keep a searchable document archive you can open in your browser.
x-display.description: Bring paperwork such as letters, receipts and records into one place you can return to. This recipe starts Paperless as an ongoing application: add and organise your documents inside the app, then search the archive when you need them.

packaging_note: Upstream's SQLite and Valkey setup with named local volumes and a loopback page. UGT asks for your archive password before starting it.

pages.what: your private document archive; sign in as archive

settings.name: ARCHIVE_PASSWORD
settings.what: a new password for the archive account
settings.how: Choose a password for this local archive. Its username is archive.

access.why: The local web service has an ordinary container network; the archive and its database stay on this computer.

known_issues: Documents are kept in the recipe's data and media volumes. Back up the archive before removing its data.
The initial account is an administrator. For shared use, create separate accounts inside Paperless.
